limitations: Paragraph groups, source blank lines, nested lists and multiline quotes use CM line structures. Full block spacing cannot be proved by a static sample.

Pixyll reference root inherits 14px from original base.css; localized CSS variables preserve that default without changing the editor global root. Custom export root sizes have separate real-browser evidence.
Whitey reference provides no Vollkorn font resource. The existing Vollkorn → Palatino → Times system stack is preserved; availability is not proved.
Only Latin subsets of PT Serif/Merriweather/Lato are packaged. CJK and unsupported glyphs still use system fallback.
This script does not run a browser. Separate real computed-style and font-load results are recorded by scripts/verify-theme-browser.mjs; use that result for browser verification.
verificationMethod: Node/PostCSS and JSDOM selector checks; no model call in this verifier
